fix_aplicado.descripcion: create_db_and_tables() crea de forma idempotente los 4 enum types nativos (user_role, staff_contract_kind, staff_contract_status, staff_contract_payment_structure) con engine.begin() + conn.exec_driver_sql() y bloques DO $$ ... EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object THEN null; END $$, antes de SQLModel.metadata.create_all(engine). Valores tomados de back/migrations/20260204100000_add_user_roles.sql y 20260325180000_staff_contract.sql.
fix_aplicado.diff:
--- /var/tmp/pos-e2e/db.py.orig
+++ /var/tmp/pos-e2e/src/back/app/db.py
@@ -10,8 +10,36 @@
     pool_pre_ping=True,
 )
 
+# E2E lab fix on the POS copy only: the models declare SAEnum(..., create_type=False),
+# so SQLModel.metadata.create_all() cannot create the native PostgreSQL enum types
+# itself. Create them idempotently before create_all, using the same DO-block
+# pattern as the repo migrations, so a fresh database boots correctly.
+_ENUM_TYPES_SQL = (
+    """DO $$ BEGIN
+    CREATE TYPE user_role AS ENUM ('owner', 'admin', 'kitchen', 'waiter', 'receptionist');
+EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object THEN null;
+END $$;""",
+    """DO $$ BEGIN
+    CREATE TYPE staff_contract_kind AS ENUM ('employee', 'freelancer');
+EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object THEN null;
+END $$;""",
+    """DO $$ BEGIN
+    CREATE TYPE staff_contract_status AS ENUM (
+        'draft', 'pending_signature', 'active', 'expired', 'superseded'
+    );
+EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object THEN null;
+END $$;""",
+    """DO $$ BEGIN
+    CREATE TYPE staff_contract_payment_structure AS ENUM ('payroll', 'invoice');
+EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object THEN null;
+END $$;""",
+)
+
 
 def create_db_and_tables() -> None:
+    with engine.begin() as conn:
+        for statement in _ENUM_TYPES_SQL:
+            conn.exec_driver_sql(statement)
     SQLModel.metadata.create_all(engine)
